scope.markdown: All Git-tracked recursive Markdown under docs/research and docs/canon, plus three named operations documents.
scope.jsonExpansion: One direct level only: directly linked source-map JSON and ontology JSON files; extract HTTP(S) values from URL-named fields only. No graph traversal or website crawling.
scope.requestUrlNormalization: The cited URL with only its fragment removed; citedUrl and original locator are retained per citation.

boundary: Inventory only. It neither downloads content nor establishes source availability, authorship, licensing, scientific correctness, HSWM efficacy, or a KG canonical-state write.
